primitives.verbatim_quote: The goal is to verify canonical sources, map practical leverage into the GSE operating system, and produce Claude Code-ready implementation packets that reduce future human input without creating license, security, data, or production risk.

primitives.name: License Compliance Filter
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Safety Rules - Secrets stay out of chat, docs, logs, screenshots, and generated prompts.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'Compliance status (0 or 1)', 'F': 'Forbidden license type flag (0 or 1)', 'R': 'Risk of license violation (0 to 1)'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: When F = 1 or R > 0.8, filter blocks integration.

layer2.mapping: Filter mimics a deterministic automaton over SPDX license identifiers.
layer2.telemetry: SPDX license identifier match and legal review status
